name: Don't Starve Together
description: Don't Starve Together dedicated server (Steam app 343050, native Linux 64-bit, anonymous login). A cluster token is REQUIRED: create it at https://accounts.klei.com/account/game/servers?game=DontStarveTogether (Klei account) and paste it in. Runs the overworld (Master shard) only: a Caves shard needs a second server process, which this definition cannot start. Cluster settings are written to /data/dst/config/Cluster on every start; /data/dst is part of the default backups. Mods: Workshop mods for DST are not downloaded via SteamCMD. They are configured in the game's own files: edit mods/dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua (ServerModSetup("workshop-ID") lines, downloaded at start) and the shard's modoverrides.lua (enable each mod) with the Files tab; both files are created empty on first start and never overwritten.

variables.label: Cluster token
variables.description: Klei server token (cluster_token.txt). Required: the server refuses to start without a valid token. Treat it like a password.

variables.label: Cluster name
variables.description: Server name shown in the browser (cluster_name).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (cluster_password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: PVP
variables.description: Allow players to damage each other (pvp).

variables.label: Pause when empty
variables.description: Pause the world while nobody is connected (pause_when_empty).

scripts.postInstall: mkdir -p /data/dst; if [ ! -e dst ] || [ -L dst ]; then rm -f dst; ln -s /data/dst dst; fi; mkdir -p /data/dst/config/Cluster/Master mods
